policy.unit: 24-trading-session portfolio window, net of simulated fees and taxes
policy.win: net return>0; zero separately flat; loss<0
policy.expectancy: sample arithmetic mean net window return = pwin*meanwin + ploss*meanloss; not future guaranteed return
policy.comparison: paired same-date sample; report beat-reference separately from positive-return win rate
policy.invalid: excluded with counts disclosed; no zero imputation
policy.inference: overlapping windows dependent; point estimates not independent trials; retain block intervals for improvements
